risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain: phishing mail delivered and link clicked (F6, F1), MFA fatigue with 7 denials then approval from 185.220.101.7 (F5), suspicious/impossible-travel sign-ins from BulwarkHost NL ASN (F4, F3), bulk SIS access (38 events/60 min) from the same IP that approved MFA (F2), and persistence/exfiltration via API-created inbox forwarding to an external Gmail (F7). The shared IP between MFA approval and bulk SIS access confirms the session is attacker-controlled. Rejected password-spray claim does not affect this account's evidence.
